title: RGB context for whole spectral scans
purpose: Help the reader recognise broad plant regions and selected candidate features. This does not establish dense spectral-to-RGB mapping.

coordinate_convention.spectral_display: Image rotated90degrees counterclockwise: display x=native scan line; display y=detector column count-1-native detector column.
coordinate_convention.rgb: Original saved distorted RGB image coordinates; no geometric warp applied to context images.

source_notes: Source displays created from nearest wavelengths to FX10[660,550,470]nm and FX17[1600,1300,1050]nm, each channel independently stretched at2nd/98th percentiles.
Full source RGB frames and exact crop bounds accompany every context view.
Candidate points reuse frozen previous-run learned matching and geometric checks; no new physical validation is implied.
